339-677-6798-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha, causing you to surveil 1
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-5256-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-5256-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3480-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

34-147-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-6798.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1445-4247-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4247-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

586-864-2279-3125-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-3125-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

654-851-1308-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

5412-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Repeat.

3110-3532-5078-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

955-1368-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
955-1368-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1734-3175-3967.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-1449-2097.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve the Plundering Barbarian trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7158.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1940-5641-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1940-5641-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

813-2104-3556.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Flicker.
813-2104-3556.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

813-961-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-961-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2018-4050-6288.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding one mana of any color.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding one mana of any color.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

1692-5315-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-5315-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-5315-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1253-5137-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1253-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Gyre Engineer's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

225-565-1987-4477.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-4477.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the land and Greenwarden of Murasa enter the battlefield, Greenwarden of Murasa and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-4477.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

914-1170-2493-2596-4074.notablePrerequisites:
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1170-2493-2596-4074.description:
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, copying Living Death.
Resolve the copy of Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Resolve Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

913-1641-2034-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

567-2966-3253-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
567-2966-3253-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Zopandrel by paying 4 life and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite lifegain and creature tokens.

372-2902-3908.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Journey to Nowhere returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Spark Double.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Journey to Nowhere until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Spark Double to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1692-4367.notablePrerequisites:
You control another modified creature that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Akki Battle Squad.
1692-4367.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Akki Battle Squad with haste.
Declare another modified creature you control as an attacker.
Akki Battle Squad triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

876-1666-1907.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Angelic Protector.
876-1666-1907.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Angelic Protector.
Angelic Protector triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Angelic Protector.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Crookclaw Transmuter by paying {3}{U}.
Crookclaw Transmuter enters the battlefield, switching Angelic Protector's power and toughness until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Angelic Protector, causing the opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

2115-2584-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
The Tree of Perdition copy enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition copy by tapping it, exchanging its toughness with target opponent's life total.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, causing the Tree of Perdition token to deal one damage the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

1494-2646-2963.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1494-2646-2963.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

570-1995.notablePrerequisites:
Gauntlets of Light attached to Faeburrow Elder.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
570-1995.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {3}{W}.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.
